newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Banco Galicia buys Banco Sudecor.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Banco Galicia buys Banco Sudecor.

text.p: Argentina's Banco de Galicia announced Wednesday that it has entered into an agreement to buy provincial Banco Sudecor.
Under the deal, Sudecor will make a share offering of about 49 percent of its capital which will be subscribed by Banco de Galicia, a statement said. The sum of the purchase was not disclosed.

In addition, Banco Galicia will have an irrevocable option to buy more shares in Sudecor. If exercised, Banco Galicia will hold a 75 percent stake in Sudecor, a bank that has its main interests in the provinces of Cordoba and Santa Fe.
The deal is conditional on the approval from Argentina's Central Bank.
"The purchase is part of Galicia's regional expansion strategy," a company official told Reuters.

Sudecor, a regional commercial bank, has a total of 80 branches in Cordoba, Santa Fe and other Argentine provinces. Its total assets stand at approximately 300 million pesos and has deposits of 200 million pesos.

Banco Galicia is the largest private sector bank in Argentina's financial system and is mainly engaged in commercial banking, providing banking services to large corporations and smaller companies, said the statement.
